reference.title: Profile status reference
reference.shortdesc: Read profile name, ID, schema, lifecycle, dirty/saved state, and validation context before acting.

section.title: Identity
section.p: Profile name and ID confirm that the current editor, Library row, or Compare selection refers to the intended saved profile or draft.

section.title: Lifecycle
section.p: Lifecycle state distinguishes active, archived, draft, restored, and deletion-sensitive profile work.

section.title: Validation
section.p: Validation context shows whether the current policy and managed-preference values are ready for save, comparison, or export.

section.title: Dirty state
section.p: Dirty/saved state tells you whether visible editor changes still need to be saved before navigation, export, or another tab is trusted.
